sentences.japanese: 崖の上から叫べば、自分の声のこだまが聞けるよ。
sentences.english: If you shout from the top of a cliff, you can hear the echo of your voice.

sentences.japanese: 崖っぷちに沿って狭い道が通っている。
sentences.english: There is a narrow path running along the cliff.

sentences.japanese: 崖からバスは落ちていった。
sentences.english: Down went the bus over the cliff.

sentences.japanese: 崖から落ちた騎手も馬もまもなく救助された。
sentences.english: The man and his horse that fell off the cliff were soon rescued.

sentences.japanese: 一歩でも動いてごらん、崖から落ちてしまうよ。
sentences.english: A single step, and you will fall over the cliff.
